content: READY marker alone survived the camera90s START timeout. Enabling after stale READY caused the existing first-motion RGB freshness guard to abort. Start capture before interactive/reset setup and require fresh frames before enable as well as during execution.
embodiment: Existing right Piper and capture_plug_calibration.py wait-trigger interface
applicability: Capture/control startup with persistent READY files
ineffective_repairs: Treat a persistent READY marker as a live camera
limitations: No relaxation of motor reset, safety limits, freshness threshold or shutdown support
